subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory roles, per-agent overrides, and hook-level role gating as the permanent public plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Implementation correctness cannot settle the long-term naming, role breadth, defaults, migration window, inheritance behavior, and Plugin SDK compatibility commitments introduced by this PR.

options.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
options.body: Approve the proposed API in principle, then require a clean rebase, explicit migration policy, and exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete runtime semantics and defer roles such as dreaming or userModel until their invocation contracts are defined.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers select another memory-composition model and later close or supersede this branch.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed API in principle, then require a clean rebase, explicit migration policy, and exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central file history and canonical issue governance make this the strongest available owner for the permanent public API decision.
